supplements.title: Therapeutic efficacy of Curcuma longa leaf extract in experimental models of arthritis.
supplements.summary: Turmeric leaf extract reduced arthritis symptoms in rats by targeting inflammation and pain pathways, offering potential as a complementary treatment.

supplements.title: Citronellol potentiates sunitinib efficacy in renal cell carcinoma by targeting JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Citronellol, a plant compound, enhances the kidney cancer drug sunitinib by blocking JAK2/STAT3 survival signals.

supplements.title: Current landscape and therapeutic prospects of indole hybrids for prostate cancer treatment: A mini-review.
supplements.summary: Indole hybrid compounds show promise for treating prostate cancer by targeting multiple pathways and overcoming drug resistance.

supplements.title: Design, synthesis, and evaluation of unsymmetrical trifluoromethyl-containing bisindolylmethane derivatives inducing endoplasmic reticulum stress in human lung adenocarcinoma.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a new compound (5b) that kills lung cancer cells by triggering stress in the endoplasmic reticulum, showing superior effectiveness compared to existing treatments.

supplements.title: Design, semisynthesis, and anti-inflammatory activity evaluation of a terphenyllin compound library for alleviating ulcerative colitis.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a terphenyllin derivative (c13) that effectively reduces inflammation in ulcerative colitis, potentially lowering cancer risk.

supplements.title: Tanshinone IIA derivatives inhibits colorectal cancer growth by targeting pyruvate kinase M2.
supplements.summary: A new Tanshinone IIA derivative slows colorectal cancer growth by activating a key enzyme and blocking cancer cell signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Discovery of novel and potent harringtonine derivative P2 via systematic structure-activity Optimization: Semi-Synthesis, anti-leukemia activity, and mechanism study.
supplements.summary: Researchers created a new leukemia drug candidate (P2) that is ten times more potent than existing treatments by blocking protein production in cancer cells.

supplements.title: Epigenetically regulated pancreatic GABA-somatostatin signaling underlies gestational diabetes-induced glucose intolerance in offspring.
supplements.summary: Maternal diabetes reduces pancreatic GABA levels in offspring, impairing insulin function; GABA supplementation restores normal glucose metabolism.

supplements.title: Merremia tridentata ethyl acetate extract suppresses HepG2 hepatocellular carcinoma cell proliferation via PCNA downregulation and mitochondria-mediated apoptosis.
supplements.summary: A plant extract from Merremia tridentata kills liver cancer cells by triggering programmed cell death and stopping cell growth.

supplements.title: Effectiveness of Qingdu Suppository on Persistent HR-HPV and Associated Factors: A Retrospective Study.
supplements.summary: Qingdu Suppository treatment helped clear persistent HPV infections in cervical cancer patients, with certain factors predicting better treatment success.

supplements.title: Integrated PASS Prediction, Molecular Networking-Guided Isolation, and Quantum Mechanics-Assisted Structure Elucidation Enable the Discovery of Cytotoxic Dimeric Sesquiterpenoids from Inulae Flos.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered seven dimeric sesquiterpenoids from Inulae Flos that showed significant cytotoxicity against liver and prostate cancer cells using data-science techniques.

supplements.title: Integrated Metabolomic and Transcriptomic Analyses Elucidate Phenolic Acid Diversity and Their Antioxidant and Functional Associations in Ocimum Species.
supplements.summary: Ocimum plants produce diverse phenolic acids that enhance antioxidant defenses and may target cancer-related proteins like AKT1 and EGFR.

supplements.title: Life's Simple 7 score and cardiovascular health in cancer survivors: the Moli-sani study.
supplements.summary: Cancer survivors with healthier cardiovascular habits showed better survival outcomes in this study.

supplements.title: 44-year journey (1980-2024): scientometric insights into Sigesbeckiae herba and update on its medicinal properties and phytochemicals profile.
supplements.summary: Sigesbeckiae herba, a traditional Chinese medicine herb, contains over 300 compounds with anti-inflammatory and potential anti-cancer properties.

supplements.title: Lipid metabolism drives dietary effects on T cell ferroptosis and immunity.
supplements.summary: Diet's fatty acid composition regulates T cell death and immunity through lipid metabolism, affecting cancer immunotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: MondoA mediates transcriptional coordination between the MYC network and the integrated stress response in pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking MondoA protein kills pancreatic cancer cells with high MYC levels by disrupting stress response pathways and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: Finerenone in Type 1 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease.
off_label.summary: Researchers are testing whether finerenone, a kidney-protective drug, works safely and effectively for type 1 diabetes patients with kidney disease.

off_label.title: Ion-Exchange and Energy-Stress Strategies Amplified Dual-Site Nanozyme-Mediated Ferroptosis/Pyroptosis Inhibition for Neuroprotection.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a nano-particle treatment that crosses the brain barrier to prevent cell death and reduce inflammation after brain hemorrhage.

off_label.title: Immunotherapy Inhibits Tumor Cholesterol Synthesis via the IFNγ-IRF1-SREBF2 Axis.
off_label.summary: Immunotherapy blocks cholesterol production in cancer cells through an immune signaling pathway, slowing tumor growth.

off_label.title: Promiscuously bioactive compounds are prevalent in widely used commercial drug repurposing libraries.
off_label.summary: Drug repurposing libraries contain many promiscuous compounds that may lead researchers astray and waste resources on ineffective clinical trials.

off_label.title: Imeglimin Exerts Anti-Tumor Activity in Multiple Myeloma Through Affecting Energy Metabolism and Downregulating IL-16 Expression.
off_label.summary: Imeglimin, an anti-diabetic drug, slows multiple myeloma growth by disrupting cancer cell energy and reducing inflammation.

off_label.title: Cardioprotective effects of prophylactic ACE inhibitors in anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials.
off_label.summary: ACE inhibitors help prevent heart damage in cancer patients receiving anthracycline chemotherapy, particularly those also taking trastuzumab.

off_label.title: Targeting the RXR Pathway for the Prevention of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
off_label.summary: RXR agonist drugs delayed or prevented triple-negative breast cancer development in mouse models with minimal side effects.

off_label.title: The multifunctional RNA helicase DDX39A drives glioblastoma progression by modulating WISP1 alternative splicing that induces an immunosuppressive macrophage polarization.
off_label.summary: DDX39A protein drives glioblastoma growth by suppressing immune cells; blocking it with a drug slows tumor progression.

off_label.title: Ribosomal profiling of the geniculate ganglion identifies the receptor ALK as critical for the development and maintenance of oral sensory neurons.
off_label.summary: ALK protein is critical for developing and maintaining taste buds and oral sensory neurons; ALK inhibitors used to treat lung cancer cause taste loss.

off_label.title: Pharmacokinetics of intra-articular delivery of flavopiridol-loaded microparticles reveal sustained effects in Lewis rats.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a sustained-release injection of flavopiridol for osteoarthritis that maintains therapeutic levels in affected joints.

off_label.title: CDK8/CDK19 inhibition restores T-cell homeostasis in primary immune thrombocytopenia.
off_label.summary: CDK8/CDK19 inhibition converts immune cells into regulatory T cells, restoring balance and reducing symptoms in immune thrombocytopenia.

off_label.title: Dasatinib boosts γδ T cell expansion and memory phenotypes with enhanced antitumor immunity.
off_label.summary: Dasatinib drug treatment enhances expansion and anti-tumor function of gamma-delta T cells against glioblastoma and breast cancer.

off_label.title: Empagliflozin and intermittent fasting as a strategy to mitigate anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity.
off_label.summary: Empagliflozin and intermittent fasting each reduce heart damage from doxorubicin chemotherapy by protecting heart cells and reducing inflammation.

off_label.title: cGAS-STING signaling in pollution-induced toxicity: mechanism and relieving medication.
off_label.summary: Environmental pollutants activate a cellular alarm pathway (cGAS-STING) causing inflammation and disease; blocking it may reduce toxicity.

biomarkers.title: Mislocalisation of FLT3-ITD receptor contributes to MV4-11 leukaemia cell resistance to antibody-drug conjugate.
biomarkers.summary: FLT3-mutated leukemia cells resist antibody-drug conjugates because the mutant receptor gets trapped in the Golgi instead of reaching lysosomes where drugs are released.

biomarkers.title: Small Hepatoid Variant of Solid Pseudopapillary Neoplasm of the Pancreas: A Unique Case With Long-term Follow-up.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers report a rare pancreatic tumor variant that remained stable without surgery during five-year follow-up, suggesting conservative monitoring may be feasible for small, asymptomatic cases.

biomarkers.title: Tumor cell-derived IFN spatially reprograms osteopontin-enriched macrophage niches to promote PARP inhibitor resistance.
biomarkers.summary: Tumor cells produce interferon that reprograms immune cells to express osteopontin, suppressing anti-cancer immunity and causing PARP inhibitor resistance in ovarian cancer.

biomarkers.title: Pretreatment MRI Versus Postoperative Pathology in Locoregional Staging of Rectal Cancer: A Germany-Wide Multicenter Re-Evaluation Study in Non-Pretreated Patients Based on the OCUM Study.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that MRI accurately stages rectal cancer before treatment, helping doctors decide whether patients need chemotherapy and radiation therapy beforehand.

biomarkers.title: Pre-existing TCR clones drive major pathological responses in HNSCC patients treated with dual immune checkpoint inhibitors.
biomarkers.summary: Pre-existing T-cell clones predict which head and neck cancer patients will respond well to dual immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment.

biomarkers.title: Genomic Therapy Matching in Rare and Refractory Cancers.
biomarkers.summary: Doctors need better evidence that matching cancer drugs to genetic mutations actually helps patients with rare, hard-to-treat cancers.

biomarkers.title: Serum total sialic acid and carcinoembryonic antigen as biomarkers in diagnosis and stratification of oral squamous cell carcinoma, oral submucous fibrosis, and periodontitis: a prospective cross-sectional analytical study.
biomarkers.summary: Two blood markers—sialic acid and CEA—effectively distinguish oral cancer and precancerous conditions from healthy tissue.

biomarkers.title: Body mass index (BMI) and risk of lung cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies using directly measured and genetically proxied measures of BMI.
biomarkers.summary: Higher BMI appears linked to increased lung cancer risk in genetic studies, contradicting traditional measured-BMI research findings.

biomarkers.title: Radiologic exposomics: imaging the environmental imprint on cancer for precision oncology.
biomarkers.summary: Medical imaging combined with environmental exposure data may help predict and understand how pollution and environmental stressors influence cancer development and progression.

biomarkers.title: Italian guidelines for the use of digital breast tomosynthesis in breast cancer screening programmes: GRADE-ADOLOPMENT of the European guidelines.
biomarkers.summary: Italian guidelines recommend digital breast tomosynthesis for breast cancer screening in women with dense breast tissue to improve detection.

biomarkers.title: ABT-737 efficiently inhibits hepatocellular carcinoma cell activity via regulating PANoptosis.
biomarkers.summary: ABT-737 drug stops hepatocellular carcinoma cells by triggering a combined cell death pathway involving multiple death mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Beyond tumor mutational burden: a framework for immune-checkpoint blockade responsiveness in gastrointestinal cancers.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers propose a new framework beyond tumor mutation count to better predict which gastrointestinal cancer patients will respond to immunotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Impact of Co-Mutations and Genetic Variations on Malignancy Risk in RAS-Positive Indeterminate Thyroid Nodules: an Institutional Experience.
biomarkers.summary: RAS mutations alone in thyroid nodules are often benign, but RAS combined with additional genetic mutations significantly increases thyroid cancer malignancy risk.

biomarkers.title: Decoding the Glioblastoma Microenvironment: AI-Driven Analysis of Cellular MRI Signatures for Targeted Therapy.
biomarkers.summary: AI analysis of brain tumor MRI scans identifies resistant tumor zones, enabling personalized therapies targeting glioblastoma and its protective microenvironment.

biomarkers.title: Amino acid metabolism-related model for prognosis and immunity in gastric cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified 16 amino acid metabolism genes that predict survival and immune response in gastric cancer patients.

trials.title: Tumor cell-derived IFN spatially reprograms osteopontin-enriched macrophage niches to promote PARP inhibitor resistance.
trials.summary: Tumor cells produce interferon that reprograms immune cells to express osteopontin, suppressing anti-cancer immunity and causing PARP inhibitor resistance in ovarian cancer.

trials.title: Pretreatment MRI Versus Postoperative Pathology in Locoregional Staging of Rectal Cancer: A Germany-Wide Multicenter Re-Evaluation Study in Non-Pretreated Patients Based on the OCUM Study.
trials.summary: Researchers found that MRI accurately stages rectal cancer before treatment, helping doctors decide whether patients need chemotherapy and radiation therapy beforehand.

trials.title: In vivo assessment of placental microstructure in normal pregnancy and gestational hypertension: An IVIM-based MRI study.
trials.summary: MRI imaging identified placental changes that can predict severe fetal growth restriction in pregnancies with high blood pressure.

trials.title: Neuroplacental Interactions in early human development: Insights from selective acute neuronal necrosis.
trials.summary: This study examines how placental problems relate to brain cell death in developing fetuses and newborns during pregnancy complications.

trials.title: Pre-existing TCR clones drive major pathological responses in HNSCC patients treated with dual immune checkpoint inhibitors.
trials.summary: Pre-existing T-cell clones predict which head and neck cancer patients will respond well to dual immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment.

trials.title: Genomic Therapy Matching in Rare and Refractory Cancers.
trials.summary: Doctors need better evidence that matching cancer drugs to genetic mutations actually helps patients with rare, hard-to-treat cancers.

trials.title: Italian guidelines for the use of digital breast tomosynthesis in breast cancer screening programmes: GRADE-ADOLOPMENT of the European guidelines.
trials.summary: Italian guidelines recommend digital breast tomosynthesis for breast cancer screening in women with dense breast tissue to improve detection.

trials.title: Automated radiosynthesis of 2-[18F]BPA for PET-based planning of boron neutron capture therapy (BNCT): rational precursor design, radiofluorination, and characterization of methodology.
trials.summary: Researchers developed an automated method to produce a fluorine-18 labeled tracer for better visualizing boron distribution in tumors during neutron capture therapy planning.

trials.title: The Hippo Pathway is Dysregulated in Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts in Anti-PD-L1 Resistant Cancer.
trials.summary: Hippo pathway dysregulation in cancer-associated fibroblasts drives immunotherapy resistance in bladder cancer, offering a potential therapeutic target.

trials.title: Cancer Susceptibility to Stapled Oncolytic Peptides is Dictated by Membrane Cholesterol and Inflammatory Signaling.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a peptide that kills leukemia cells by targeting their membranes, with effectiveness determined by cholesterol levels and inflammatory signaling.

trials.title: Effects of Radiotherapy in Normal Tissue.
trials.summary: Modern radiotherapy improves tumor control while reducing side effects through better imaging, planning, and dose delivery techniques.

trials.title: Finerenone in Type 1 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease.
trials.summary: Researchers are testing whether finerenone, a kidney-protective drug, works safely and effectively for type 1 diabetes patients with kidney disease.

trials.title: The efficacy of combination therapy versus monotherapy in patients with glioblastoma with abnormal epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) genes, a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Combination therapies with targeted drugs plus temozolomide outperform single-drug treatments in glioblastoma patients with abnormal EGFR genes.

trials.title: Advances in novel modification strategies for enhancing the tumor tissue specificity of PROTACs.
trials.summary: Scientists developed strategies to make PROTACs, a cancer-fighting drug technology, accumulate specifically in tumors while reducing harmful side effects.

trials.title: Prognostic Significance of Circulating Tumor Cells in Patients with Esophageal Cancer Who Attained Pathological Complete Response after Neoadjuvant Therapy.
trials.summary: Circulating tumor cells can identify esophageal cancer patients at high recurrence risk despite achieving complete tumor response after chemotherapy.
